description: Tasks template for modernization plan. Generate this file alongside plan.md to track individual migration tasks.

tasks.description: Migrate the Oracle Database data source to Azure Database for PostgreSQL. Replace the Oracle JDBC driver with the PostgreSQL driver, update Spring datasource configuration, convert Hibernate dialect, and adapt any Oracle-specific SQL syntax (including BLOB to bytea for photo data storage).
tasks.reason: The application currently uses Oracle Database with Oracle-specific JDBC driver, OracleDialect, BLOB data types, and plaintext credentials. Azure Database for PostgreSQL is the target managed relational database service on Azure, eliminating the need for self-managed Oracle infrastructure and enabling managed identity authentication.
tasks.requirements: Replace the Oracle data source with Azure Database for PostgreSQL and use managed identity authentication instead of plaintext credentials. Replace ojdbc8 Oracle JDBC driver dependency with PostgreSQL JDBC driver. Update Spring datasource configuration and Hibernate dialect for PostgreSQL. Convert Oracle BLOB columns used to store photo binary data to PostgreSQL bytea and adapt any Oracle-specific SQL in repositories to PostgreSQL-compatible syntax. Update datasource configuration to point to Azure Database for PostgreSQL.
